title: always-true-assign (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: An assigned stdClass is truthy and retains its object type inside the condition. A nullable assignment has both outcomes, and its true branch also safely accesses the object.

allowed.reason: The condition always returns through the truthy branch; this return is genuinely unreachable.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Shares the existing semantic criterion. The new fixture adds assignment-context or callable-string controls; it is not a new criterion. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation.
